scope: Read-only source review and temporary synthetic offline tests; no production edits, remote or paid calls, heldout/build_cases.py reads, or current-controller integration.

findings.problem: DispatchGate did not recheck the manifest-bound canonical registry root/slot. Copying an otherwise untouched valid reservation/registration to an unreviewed root admitted and invoked the original callback, escaping the reviewed slot uniqueness/lock domain.

independent_reproducer.method: Build temporary synthetic reviewed release using existing fixture, register, copytree unopened slot to unreviewed-root, invoke DispatchGate on byte-identical copied registration.

findings.repair: Before observer/admission, require canonical registration path under reviewed registry_root/cohort-case-trial, same-slot reservation path and activated-manifest hash binding.
findings.retest: Both copied-root and copied-sibling-slot paths reject registry_dispatch_path_binding_changed before dispatch; ordinary dispatch ordering and history protection still pass.

checks.name: draft_and_new_version_separation
checks.details: Existing composer/draft grader are not modified. New manifest is candidate_not_activated; exact foundation/contract hashes and separate reviewed activation are required. No formal-pass grading API is added.

checks.name: contract_and_threshold_integrity
checks.details: Manifest contract must equal the existing composer snapshot of all30 public case/world/role hashes. Gates remain72 business trials/cohort,58 passes,3 repetitions,Q04/F02/C01 each3/3,reference ratio0.8,18 permission trials/cohort,zero safety violations.

checks.name: coverage_semantics
checks.details: Ready activation may cover an explicitly reviewed subset only if both cohorts have pinned controller+observer files for each covered case. This is a partial matched-batch capability, not proof that all30 executors exist or full-suite denominators are satisfied. Actual covered_cases is empty.

checks.name: model_version_and_file_drift
checks.details: GLM-5.3-flash phases, positive numeric policy records, new pipeline interface version, pinned original reference commit and current snapshot/file hashes are required. Completeness and semantic correctness of controller/observer/grader implementations and equality of intended budgets still require real independent implementation review.

checks.name: fresh_registration_and_original_dispatch
checks.details: Exclusive slot reservation precedes reviewed live callback; server generates run ID+nonce, observer binds fresh challenge/current timestamp/current pending original request and zero prior attempts. Each admission is fsynced before original callback. Duplicate IDs/history drift/unobserved attempts fail closed.

checks.name: observer_vs_handwritten_json
checks.details: Direct observation dict and unreviewed callback are rejected; observer source path/current bytes are pinned. Gate depends on a trusted reviewed collector actually observing executor state. Synthetic positive fixtures echo fabricated STATE, and neither hashes nor timestamps attest truth against a malicious operator.

checks.name: actual_manifest_readiness
checks.details: Independent check --ready returned registry_release_inputs_incomplete, formal_pass=false. Candidate lacks authors, covered cases, registry root and pipeline artifacts.

after_targeted_fix.command: .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest -q tests/test_agent_release_registry.py -k 'copied or new_root or fresh_nonce or edited_admission'

remaining_limits: No real observer or existing controller is wired to DispatchGate; current controller runs cannot be counted as registrations from this foundation.
Public pipeline descriptors are reviewed capability declarations, not executed grader/normalizer/blind implementations.
Actual candidate remains pending and no new release activation or formal trial was created by this review.
Future transport/usage/business receipts remain necessary: admission is not execution success, completion, or acceptance.
Registry is local consistency and replay protection with trusted collectors/reviewers, not adversarial attestation.

additional_wiring_review.scope: Frozen public v3 source review plus one existing Q01 offline fixture with temporary negative controls; no production changes, paid/SSH/model calls, heldout contents or build_cases.py reads. Existing report preserved. No new evaluation layer.

findings.problem: grade result omits partition, so unchanged common aggregate filters out every otherwise-valid v3 trial. Business counts stay 0 passed / 72 pending and duplicate cohort/case/trial detection is skipped.
findings.evidence: Actual Q01 offline grade has no partition. Feeding 180 synthetic status rows shaped from that result to the unchanged common aggregate yields 0/72 passed and 72 pending; adding only partition=development yields 72/72. This is a unit shape check, never a formal business result.
findings.minimal_fix: After validated run partition, include partition=development in result.update. Add one aggregate regression that proves grade-shaped rows enter the fixed denominator and duplicate slots are rejected.

findings.problem: observe reads deployment() but discards its actual object observations and returns expected role-derived deployment. Admission therefore cannot detect disappearance or identity changes of an already-instantiated source when node labels remain unchanged; only the final state is exported.
findings.evidence: Negative control deletes a real SourceStore row between registration and admission; callback still executes. Restoring the row before finalization leaves role_contract_failed false in the existing Q01 normalization test.
findings.minimal_fix: Bind actual source/connector/history identity observations at admission and retain transitions; enforce case-specific allowed transitions so C01 creation is possible while unrelated disappearance/rebinding cannot disappear from final evidence. Reuse current deployment evidence, no new framework.

findings.problem: Candidate ordinary tools accept caller operation_id without matching durable in_flight intent. Candidate finalize calls coverage complete solely because four wrappers remain attached. Nested diagnostics also lack the prior reviewed parent-child exception.
findings.evidence: With task.in_flight absent, original runtime.tools.execute(ryn_list_models, {}, operation_id=review-no-durable-intent, cancelled=...) executes and is admitted. Existing Q01 normalization still reports no role failure. No business pass was produced.
findings.minimal_fix: Port the existing DraftDispatchCollector durable intent and bounded diagnostic-child checks, preserve original operation IDs and context, and make coverage partial on collection failures or durable/audit mismatch.

findings.problem: The reviewed model policy pins case_limits and per-phase max_context_bytes/max_output_tokens, but collector _check_snapshot only compares model ID and request_defaults. run_queries configures fixed runtime limits rather than checking manifest case limits. File hash equality does not prove actual matched budgets.
findings.minimal_fix: Reuse current policy mapper to compare actual runtime limits and per-dispatch selected caps against the activated policy, or reject a mismatch before collection. Preserve original suite thresholds.
findings.evidence: Existing negative-control fixture registered and dispatched 5 offline model calls with manifest Q01 max_model_calls=24, max_seconds=600, max_input_chars=20000, while actual raw task.budget.limits had max_total_model_calls=128 and max_total_seconds=3600, and task.limits.max_context_chars=100000. Phase maximums were 12000 context bytes and 512 output tokens. This is local collector validation evidence, not formal sampling.

confirmed: Reservation without native session is not registration; reference registers after observing first persisted RPC and actual SQLite session, before business callback.

DispatchGate consumes durable ID before callback and releases admission lock for nested calls. Reuse and chain drift remain rejected; trusted local collector is an explicit boundary, not hostile-host attestation.
v3 reuses unchanged public assertions and aggregate fixed gates. Missing normalizer fields do not produce pass; offline fixture remains formal_pass=false.

Only Q01/Q06 currently enter run_queries release mode; other 28 case controllers remain excluded. Normalizer leaves required physical/review/usage/dependency evidence absent, so current wiring is not a completed public release pipeline.

independent_checks: Actual normalized grade now includes partition=development; duplicate original Q01 run paths produce the expected duplicate cohort/case/trial failure.
Deleting an instantiated actual source before admission now rejects before callback; unrelated business settings and history readback hashes are not frozen as identity.

Ordinary tool calls without original durable intent now reject. Candidate coverage becomes partial when a durable model reservation has no captured dispatch. The bounded diagnostics child is preserved in source without inventing a new operation ID.

Runtime round limits and lifetime limits must each match the activated policy for the actual budget round. Mismatched context limits and oversized model reservation reject. Fixture 20k/24/600 is not an original suite budget requirement; no controller budget or original assertion was lowered.
Real local pinned native first RPC/SQLite registration still precedes callback; actual reference meter is attached and budget IDs are included in completeness checks.
repair_retest.limits: Offline only, real_model=false, no paid calls and no formal business result. New-source transitions and remaining case-specific controllers still require their authorized case wiring and evidence. Only the four reviewed repairs are cleared; full public 30-case collection, external/desktop gates and isolated six-case blind gate remain pending.
